description: This file defines the class SugarWidgetSubPanelActivitiesStatusField, which extends SugarWidgetField and provides a method to display a list value for a subpanel activities status field in the SugarCRM/SuiteCRM environment.

classes.name: SugarWidgetSubPanelActivitiesStatusField
classes.description: A widget class for rendering the activities status subpanel field.

methods.name: displayList
methods.description: Returns the display value for the list view of the activities status field based on the layout definition and current language.
